description: #454 — "who changed or deleted what, and when" across every user in the workspace, filterable by actor/entity/date range (default: last 30 days). Reads the SAME activity_events/record_field_changes tables list_comments/get_history read per-record, just workspace-wide. A removed member still appears by name (the no-FK design). [Full notes: get_started section "TOOL NOTES list_audit_log"]

actor.description: Narrow to one user id (from list_members).

entity.description: Narrow to one record, space, database or view id.

from.description: ISO datetime, inclusive. Default: 30 days ago.

source.description: #934 — narrow to actions by these kinds of actor, comma-separated: human, agent, automation, mcp (e.g. "agent,mcp" for what agents did). Each event row also carries credential_id (which token did it) and agent_id/agent_name.

type.description: #1059 — narrow to event types, comma-separated, e.g. "space.deleted,database.deleted,view.deleted,database.restricted". Omit for everything.

name: list_audit_log
title: Workspace-wide audit log
